# Comparison: baselines and fine-tuned transformers (generated by ml/make_comparison.py)

Cleaned labels. `plain` = trained on `train.parquet`; `+aug` = trained on `train_augmented.parquet` (train + 800 synthetic indirect-injection rows). C / epoch and the decision threshold were chosen on val only; test, indirect_eval, tricky and xstest were scored once with those frozen choices. Brackets are bootstrap 95% CIs over rows (1,000 resamples, seed 42). Baselines ran locally (sklearn); transformers ran on a Colab T4 (`ml/train_transformer.ipynb`, one seed, so seed-to-seed variance is unmeasured).

## 2. Tricky set per category (correct/total)

| model | train | hidden injection document | benign document | benign mentions instructions | benign suspicious | sneaky attack | short attack | hinglish | long benign |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| length only (LR) | plain | 5/5 | 0/6 | 0/5 | 0/6 | 6/6 | 0/5 | 5/11 | 0/5 |
| length only (LR) | +aug | 5/5 | 0/6 | 0/5 | 0/6 | 6/6 | 0/5 | 5/11 | 0/5 |
| word TF-IDF (LR) | plain | 1/5 | 6/6 | 2/5 | 6/6 | 4/6 | 5/5 | 9/11 | 5/5 |
| word TF-IDF (LR) | +aug | 1/5 | 5/6 | 1/5 | 6/6 | 5/6 | 5/5 | 9/11 | 5/5 |
| word+char TF-IDF (LR) | plain | 0/5 | 6/6 | 2/5 | 6/6 | 4/6 | 3/5 | 7/11 | 5/5 |

| MiniLM frozen emb (LR) | +aug | 1/5 | 4/6 | 2/5 | 4/6 | 5/6 | 4/5 | 10/11 | 4/5 |
| MiniLM fine-tuned | plain | 1/5 | 6/6 | 3/5 | 6/6 | 6/6 | 4/5 | 5/11 | 5/5 |
| MiniLM fine-tuned | +aug | 0/5 | 5/6 | 2/5 | 6/6 | 6/6 | 4/5 | 6/11 | 5/5 |
| DeBERTa-v3-small fine-tuned | plain | 0/5 | 6/6 | 3/5 | 6/6 | 6/6 | 5/5 | 7/11 | 5/5 |
| DeBERTa-v3-small fine-tuned | +aug | 3/5 | 6/6 | 1/5 | 4/6 | 6/6 | 5/5 | 5/11 | 5/5 |

Category sizes are 5-11 rows, so one row is 9-20 points; a 1-2 row swing is noise. `hidden injection document` and `sneaky attack` / `short attack` contain attacks; `benign *`, `hinglish` (benign half) and `long benign` contain benign rows (hinglish has 6 benign + 5 attacks).
